contentList.content: Hardened by the concrete jungles of San Francisco and Los Angeles, the Homeless Californian channels makeshift biological warfare, erratic street fury, and the gravity-defying equilibrium of the legendary Fent Lean.
Master of chemical concoctions and sidewalk biohazards. Amplifies the potency of toxic clouds and explosive biological payloads, until every strike drips with poison.
A ferocious close-quarters pugilist specializing in improvised shivs, reckless flurries, and chaotic shopping cart charges.
An erratic street phantom who slips through turnstiles and spatial dimensions, never quite where the enemy expects.
A survivalist who keeps house in concrete flood channels and under freeway overpasses. The ground is always doing something. You are used to it.

Hurl a handful of raw biological waste at a target. On a hit, deals 1d10 + Constitution Bludgeoning (2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10) and 1d6 Poison damage, leaves a puddle of filth, and inflicts Fecal Stench for 2 turns. Can be used as often as you like.

Hurl a dense, fermented payload with devastating force. On a hit, deals an extra 1d10 Bludgeoning on top of Sling Poop (3d10 + Constitution at level 5, 4d10 at level 10) and 2d6 Poison damage, leaves a wider puddle of filth, and inflicts Fecal Stench for 3 turns. Can be used as often as you like.
Flick a concentrated dose at an enemy. Deals 2d6 Psychic damage. On a failed Constitution saving throw the target falls into Fent Stupor for 2 turns. Recharges on a Short Rest.

Scatter an entire contraband brick across a 4m area. Every creature caught takes 5d6 Psychic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw or fall into Fent Stupor until the end of its next turn; on a success, half damage. Recharges on a Short Rest.

Fold forward at a perfect, gravity-defying 90-degree angle as a Bonus Action. For 3 turns you have Resistance to all damage, +3 Armour Class, Advantage on Constitution and Dexterity saving throws, and cannot be knocked Prone, but you cannot move. Narcan ends it for free. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Jam a dose of Narcan up your nose and snap your spine back upright with a terrifying pop, ending Fent Lean. Costs nothing.
Scurry frantically across broken glass and hazardous surfaces. As a Bonus Action, Dash and gain +3m movement and immunity to difficult terrain and being knocked Prone until the end of your next turn.

Shake a rusty cup aggressively at every enemy within 6m. Each must make a Wisdom saving throw or become Socially Shamed for 2 turns (Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and they cannot take Reactions). Recharges on a Short Rest.

Unleash an unhinged, ear-splitting 3 AM shriek. Every enemy within 9m takes 6d6 Thunder damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened for 2 turns; on a success, half damage and no fear. Recharges on a Short Rest.

Throw up a tarp-and-shopping-cart bunker. You and every ally within 5m gain 15 Temporary Hit Points, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage for 3 turns, and Sanctuary for 1 turn. Recharges on a Long Rest.

Lob a pressurised five-gallon bucket of aged street slop. Explodes in a 4m radius dealing 6d6 Poison and 3d6 Acid damage (half on a successful Dexterity saving throw), inflicts Fecal Stench on anyone who fails, and leaves a lingering poison cloud. Recharges on a Short Rest.
As a Bonus Action, drive a jagged malt liquor bottleneck into a vital organ. Deals 2d6 + Constitution Piercing and 1d6 Slashing damage and inflicts Bleeding for 2 turns.

Shove a rattling grocery cart packed with scrap metal up to 9m into the enemy ranks, hitting the first creature in your path for 4d8 + Constitution Bludgeoning damage. On a failed Strength saving throw, the target is knocked Prone. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Slip through the fabric of reality like hopping a transit barrier. Teleport up to 18m as a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
Overwhelmed by nauseating biological stench. Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, and takes 1d4 Poison damage at the end of each turn.
Slumped in an unresponsive narcotic daze. Incapacitated: cannot move, act or react. Taking damage does not wake them.
Locked in supreme postural equilibrium. Resistant to all damage, +3 AC, Advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saving throws, immune to Prone, but cannot move.
+3m movement. Immune to difficult terrain and being knocked Prone.
Deeply rattled by persistent street solicitation. Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and cannot take Reactions.
Years of dumpster exposure have forged an impenetrable immune system. Immune to Poisoned and Disease, and Resistant to Poison damage.
While not wearing armour, your Armour Class equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You can still use a shield.
While in Fent Lean, your slowed metabolism knits wounds back together, restoring 2d6 + Constitution Hit Points at the start of each of your turns.
While in Fent Lean, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 2d10 Psychic damage from sheer cognitive dissonance.

Petty theft under 950 gold is decriminalised. Whenever you hit an enemy with a melee attack, you snatch a Stolen Patagonia Vest (+1 AC, +1d4 damage on weapon attacks) for 2 turns. Authorities will apologise for profiling you.
Warm, fleece-lined, and acquired without prosecution. +1 Armour Class and +1d4 Bludgeoning damage on weapon attacks.

Rummaging through the coats of foes marinating in your biological weaponry is sustenance. Once per turn, when you damage a creature that has Fecal Stench, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier + 2.
Fortified by whatever was in that coat. Grants Temporary Hit Points.

As a Bonus Action, serve a foe with an immediate lease termination. On a failed Wisdom saving throw the target takes 3d6 Psychic damage and suffers Rent Hike for 3 turns: -2 AC, -3m movement, and 2d6 Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns from Bay Area cost of living. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Crushed by runaway housing costs. -2 AC, -3m movement, and takes 2d6 Psychic damage at the start of each turn.
An unbearable 3m miasma radiates from you. Enemies within it reek of Fecal Stench.
Radiating an unbearable 3m stench. Nearby enemies are afflicted with Fecal Stench.
The first time each combat that the municipal cleanup crew drops you below half Hit Points, you reflexively collapse into Fent Lean for 2 turns and gain 20 Temporary Hit Points.
Your survival reflexes need time to reset.

Subject every enemy within 9m to the purgatory of municipal hold music. On a failed Wisdom saving throw, for 3 turns they cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions and their movement is halved. Costs only a Bonus Action. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold. Cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions, and movement is halved.
Survival on the block keeps you moving. +3m movement and +3 to Initiative.
You have survived things that would kill a dragon. Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened or Charmed.
Your body found a doorway to curl up in. Grants Temporary Hit Points.
Huddled under a tarp bunker. Temporary Hit Points and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
Your poison damage ignores Resistance, and your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 Poison damage.
Your body is a walking public-health emergency. Your weapon attacks deal a further 2d6 Poison damage, and you are immune to Poison damage.
Venice gym regulars taught you everything. Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d8 Bludgeoning damage, and you gain +2 Armour Class.
Nothing on the boardwalk scares you anymore. You score critical hits on a roll of 18-20, and you heal 1d8 Hit Points whenever you hit with a melee attack.
You are never where they expect. +4.5m movement, immunity to difficult terrain, and you learn Express Hop.
No fare, no wait, no action. Teleport up to 9m for free. Once per turn.

Hailing from the Golden State, Californians possess an uncanny resilience shaped by natural disasters, gridlock traffic, and perpetual microclimates. Whether meditating on a Malibu beach or pitching a seed-stage venture in a coffee shop, they navigate Faerûn with effortless chill and passive aggression.
Sun-drenched coastal dwellers who surf metaphysical waves. Radiant resistance, supreme mobility, and the innate ability to 'Hang Ten' across treacherous surfaces.
Disruptive visionaries fortified by microdosed mushroom tea and quarterly pitch decks. Channels psychic energy to disrupt hostile thought patterns and optimize output.
Forged in extreme heatwaves, agricultural dust, and unending highway commutes. Virtually immune to toxic air, burning conditions, and high-temperature environments.
Select your spiritual California identity and pronoun archetype. Each comes with bespoke perks, cultural flair, and cosmic validation.
A timeless, universal California vibration. You greet gods, goblins, and dragons alike as 'dude'. You gain +2 to Persuasion checks and Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.
You operate in perpetual stealth mode. Treating every battle as a Series-A pitch, you gain +2 to Initiative and Advantage on Deception checks when bluffing.
Completely organic, non-GMO, and free of inflammatory systemic toxins. You are completely immune to the Poisoned condition.
Your chakras are aligned to the exact resonant frequency of Sedona crystals. At the start of combat, you automatically manifest 5 Temporary Hit Points.
You have surrendered all bodily autonomy to predictive machine learning models. You gain a +1 bonus to all Saving Throws as incoming attacks are forecasted in real-time.

Touch a foe and force them to disconnect from online discourse. Deals 1d8 Psychic damage, immediately terminates any active Rage, Frenzy, or Enraged condition, and inflicts Existential Daze (Disadvantage on Attack Rolls for 2 turns).
Nourish yourself with artisanal sourdough topped with mashed Hass avocado and flaky sea salt. Restores 1d6 + CON modifier Hit Points and grants 5 Temporary Hit Points.
Catch the cosmic Pacific swell. Increases movement speed by 3m and grants immunity to difficult terrain and slipping on ice or grease for 2 turns.
Subject a target's consciousness to a brutal seed-stage vibe check. Target must succeed a DC Wisdom saving throw or break concentration and become Vibe Checked.
Born on the San Andreas Fault, you possess impeccable footing. You cannot be knocked Prone.
Decades spent idling on the I-405 freeway have made you immune to gridlock. You cannot be Slowed or Restrained.
Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed. Any attempt to rezone your opinions requires a twelve-month public comment period, and you will be attending every hearing.
Central Valley dust and Los Angeles smog have turned your respiratory system into an industrial air filter. Advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned, and immune to Disease.
Triple-digit Palm Springs heat is merely room temperature to you. Immune to Burning condition.
Cross-functional synergy allows you to optimize output. Once per turn, dealing weapon damage deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.
Disconnected from rage by reality. Suffers Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
Fortified by artisanal healthy fats. Grants Temporary Hit Points.
Surfing metaphysical waves. +3m Movement Speed and immune to slipping or difficult terrain.
Concentration broken and mind disrupted by venture capital reality.
From a lifetime of mandatory uphill power-walking in high-end activewear and hauling organic groceries, your jump distance is increased by 50% and your carrying capacity is increased by 25%.

Take a soothing sip from your dented 40-oz vacuum-insulated flask. Restores 1d8 + Constitution modifier Hit Points, cures Poisoned, and quenches any burning surface beneath you with pure cold water. Once per short rest.

Whip a foe with the treacherous undertow of the Pacific. Make a melee spell attack: on a hit it deals 2d6 Cold damage, pulls the target 4.5 m toward you, knocks them Prone on a failed Strength save, and creates a puddle of seawater. Once per short rest.

Radiate the blinding, intensely flattering light of a Malibu sunset. Enemies in a 6 m radius make a Constitution saving throw or are Blinded for 2 turns. You gain +3 m movement and deal +1d4 Radiant damage on weapon attacks for 2 turns. Once per long rest.
Bathed in ethereal coastal sunlight. Movement speed increased by 3 m and weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.
Pivot away from current market conditions. Teleport up to 9 m to an unoccupied space. You gain Advantage on your next attack roll as enemies struggle to parse your new roadmap. Once per long rest.
Capitalizing on recent market disruption. Advantage on your next attack roll.

Enforce aggressive legal silence on a target. Deals 2d8 Psychic damage (half on a successful Wisdom save). On a failed Wisdom save, the target is Silenced for 2 turns. The terms of this combat are strictly confidential. Once per long rest.
Kick up an abrasive whirlwind of Mojave dust and alkaline gravel. You gain Blur for 1 turn, and enemies in a 3 m radius make a Constitution save or are Blinded for 1 turn. Once per short rest.
Spew a 6 m cone of lifted-truck diesel exhaust and superheated valley smog. Deals 2d8 Poison and 1d8 Fire damage (Constitution save for half damage). Once per long rest.

Subject an enemy to the brutal 115-degree Bakersfield midday sun. Deals 3d8 Fire damage (half on a successful Constitution save). On a failed save, the target suffers Heatstroke for 2 turns (movement halved, disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength and Dexterity saves). Once per long rest.
Overcome by blistering valley heat. Movement speed is halved; Disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
A small collection of things you will definitely need. Fuels your junk toolkit; replenished on short rest.
Not enough Junk. The good rubbish has already been spoken for.
+2 AC, advantage on Strength saves, and immunity to Prone. The chair has passed its own inspection.
+6 m movement and immunity to difficult terrain. The property line is wherever you stop next.
Unlocks Chair-Leg Shiv. This chair has been in the family since Tuesday.
+2 AC, advantage on Constitution saves, and immunity to Prone and difficult terrain. You have established residency on this sidewalk.
Paperwork asserts this is an ordinary municipal pigeon. Unlocks Pigeon Lunch Rush.
Mobbed by aggressive pigeons squabbling over sidewalk crumbs. Disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.
Hurl a beloved brick: 2d6 + Constitution modifier Bludgeoning on a ranged spell hit. A failed Constitution save causes Dazed for 1 turn. You cannot throw this away. You might need it.
Create a 2.5 m web surface for 3 turns. Requires concentration; can trap allies as well as enemies and can burn. Every bag contains another bag. None contains an exit.
Gain +2 AC, advantage on Strength saves, and immunity to Prone for 2 turns. This folding chair is the only stable institution left.

Outside combat, restore 2 Junk up to your maximum and scavenge discarded edible rations (a piece of cheese and a half-eaten apple). Once per short rest. Ownership is a theory you are willing to discuss later.

While in Fent Lean, end it for free, gain +6 m movement and difficult-terrain immunity for 1 turn, and scatter a 2.5 m perimeter of discarded rubbish (difficult terrain) for 2 turns where you stood. Once per short rest. Your forwarding address is already incorrect.

Stake your claim on this patch of ground for 2 turns. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. Gain +2 AC, advantage on Constitution saves, and immunity to Prone, while scattering a 2.5 m perimeter of protective rubbish (difficult terrain) for 2 turns around you. You have lived here for fifteen minutes. That is legal precedence.

Summon a raven familiar that can scout, use its normal familiar abilities, and command a Pigeon Lunch Rush to distract enemies. Replaces your existing familiar. Once per short rest. It is visibly a raven; the pigeon paperwork is airtight.

The pigeon creates a chaotic flap of oily wings and dropped French fries in a 4 m radius. Enemies who fail a Dexterity saving throw suffer Disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saves for 1 turn. Once per short rest. Someone dropped half a croissant. It is serious.

Melee weapon attack: 3d6 + Constitution modifier Bludgeoning. A failed Strength save knocks Prone for 1 turn. A hit readies Chair-Leg Shiv for 2 turns. This chair has been in the family since Tuesday.
Bonus-action melee weapon attack: 2d6 + Constitution modifier Piercing. Consumes your prepared chair leg, hit or miss. Some assembly was required. Less is required now.
An enemy within 9 m makes a Wisdom save. On failure, swap positions with it. Once per short rest. You wanted the other platform. Everyone does.
Several layers of disputed ownership. The holes provide essential ventilation.
A cloak promoted to roof, blanket, and legal address. Structurally sound until asked.
Find a set of Municipally Approved Layers and a Load-Bearing Tarp. Added to your inventory; equip them yourself. Ownership investigations are ongoing.

A shopping cart of unknown origin, three owners deep and one wheel short of a plan. It holds the whole supply chain: you, your things, and a squeak that announces you to every shift supervisor in the county. Property of nobody, which is nearly the same as yours.

Produce an abandoned shopping cart on the ground within 6 m. Costs a bonus action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. It is decoration with opinions: a wire-basket monument to everything somebody could not carry home. Nobody saw where it came from. Nobody ever does.
Unlock a door or container within 1.5 m. Costs an action and 1 Junk. Cannot open magical locks. Every lock is a suggestion with paperwork.

Cure Poisoned, Diseased, Blinded and Paralysed on a living ally within 1.5 m, and restore 2d6 + Constitution modifier Hit Points. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. The clinic has no address. It has standards.

Declared a municipal biohazard condemnation zone for 3 turns. Enemies within 6 m suffer Fecal Stench (disadvantage on attack rolls and turn-based poison damage). You gain advantage on Concentration checks and can cast Condemn.
Holding the property by force for 3 turns. You gain advantage on attack rolls, and can strike with an Emergency Chair-Leg Shiv using a Bonus Action once per turn without preparing furniture first.

You command the transit interchange for 3 turns. Gain +1 Reaction and +4.5 m movement speed. Unlocks Platform Rescue to swap positions with willing allies, and Wrong Platform Express to swap enemies using a Bonus Action.
You hold the spillway for 3 turns. +2 Armour Class and +3 m movement speed.

Bonus Action: Claim this territory as a declared biohazard zone for 3 turns, and restore all Junk. Radiates Fecal Stench to all enemies within 6 m, protects concentration, and unlocks Condemn. Once per Long Rest. Possession is nine-tenths of the law. You have been possessing since Tuesday.

Hurl concentrated biohazard waste at an enemy: 3d8 Poison damage on a failed Constitution save (half damage on save), and inflicts Fecal Stench for 3 turns. Costs 1 Action and 2 Junk. Once per turn while Condemned Block is active.

Bonus Action: Surge into total territorial defense. Gain an immediate additional Action this turn (Action Surge), 3 turns of Eviction Defense (advantage on attack rolls, bonus-action Chair-Leg Shiv once per turn), and restore all Junk. Once per Long Rest. Some assembly was required. None will be accepted from the landlord.

Bonus Action melee weapon attack: 2d6 + Constitution modifier Piercing damage. Ready-to-use splinter weapon usable once per turn while Eviction Defense is active without needing to smash furniture first.

Bonus Action: Establish undisputed control of the transit hub for 3 turns, and restore all Junk. Gain +1 Reaction, +4.5 m movement speed, and unlock Platform Rescue (allied position swap) and Wrong Platform Express (bonus-action enemy position swap). Once per Long Rest. Stand clear of the closing doors.

Bonus Action: Declare the spillway yours for 3 turns, and restore all Junk. Gain +2 AC and +3 m movement speed, and the ground within 4 m turns to mud (difficult terrain) for 3 turns. Once per Long Rest. The water rises, the water falls, and you are still here.
Bonus Action: Swap positions with a willing ally within 12 m. Costs 1 Bonus Action and 1 Junk. Pull an overextended partner back to safety or slingshot them into position.
Bonus Action: Target an enemy within 9 m. On a failed Wisdom saving throw, instantly swap positions with it. Costs 1 Bonus Action and 1 Junk; once per turn while Last Train Out is active.
Immune to being knocked Prone and to difficult terrain. Standing on a 40-degree slab of wet concrete is a skill, and you have the certificate.
Resistance to Fire and Cold damage. The underpass is eleven degrees cooler in summer and eleven degrees warmer in winter. Nobody knows why.
+1 Armour Class and advantage on Strength saving throws. They tried to move you along. The rebar disagreed.
+2 Armour Class and advantage on Dexterity saving throws. It is waterproof in the way that matters.

Open the storm drain and let the municipality explain itself. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. Creatures in a 9 m line make a Strength saving throw, taking 2d8 + Constitution modifier Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success. Leaves standing water for 2 turns. The sign said do not enter during rain. You were already in the channel.

Rig a blue tarp over everyone within 3 m. Costs a bonus action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. You and your allies gain +2 AC and advantage on Dexterity saving throws for 2 turns, and fire on the ground is doused. It has held up through three storms and one very determined raccoon.

Draw clean runoff from the culvert and pour it over a friend. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. An ally or yourself within 9 m regains 2d6 + Constitution modifier Hit Points, stops Burning, and the ground is doused. It is mostly water. Mostly.
They have stopped seeing you, and honestly everything else too. Attack rolls against them have advantage.
Pressing hands against a wall that is not there. Cannot move.
A flock has taken an interest. Attack rolls against the target have advantage, and its own attack rolls have disadvantage.
Cited for invalid transit credentials. Movement speed is reduced by 3 m and reactions are blocked.

Make it land. Costs a bonus action and 1 Junk. Deals 1d6 + Constitution modifier Psychic damage. If the target is Socially Shamed, it takes an extra 2d6 Psychic damage and the shame is spent. Do you have any idea what groceries cost?
Escalate. Costs an action and 1 Junk. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or becomes Frightened for 1 turn (2 turns if already Socially Shamed, spending the shame). Everyone is looking. Everyone.
An invisible box appears. It is extremely real to the target. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or cannot move for 1 turn.
Their patience snaps. Costs a bonus action and 1 Junk. Deals 2d6 Psychic damage. If the target suffers from Homeless Fatigue, it takes an extra 2d6 Psychic damage and the fatigue ends.

Ask a non-hostile stranger for spare change. Costs an action; once per short rest. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they hand over 5 gold. Either way they gain Homeless Fatigue and will not be swayed again.

Play the five-gallon bucket like it owes you money. Costs an action and 1 Junk. Creatures in the cone make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 Thunder damage and being pushed back on a failure, or half damage on a success. Failures gain Homeless Fatigue for 3 turns.

Rent out your doorway. Costs an action and 1 Junk. An ally within 9 m gets the Lawn Chair treatment for 2 turns: +2 AC, advantage on Strength saving throws and immunity to being knocked Prone. You do not get it. Rent is due.

The flock knows who owes them lunch. Costs an action and 1 Junk. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or becomes Breadcrumbed for 2 turns: attack rolls against it have advantage, and its own attack rolls have disadvantage.
Hurl a swollen scooter battery. Costs an action and 1 Junk. Ranged spell attack for 2d6 Lightning plus 2d6 Fire damage, and it sets the ground alight. Indoors, mind your friends.

The inspector has arrived. Your paperwork has not. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Fined for 2 turns (-3 m movement speed, cannot take reactions).

Smash a heavy folding lawn chair into the target with the full weight of the boardwalk behind it. Costs an action and 1 Junk; once per short rest. Melee weapon attack that deals weapon damage plus 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a failed Strength saving throw, the target is knocked Prone.
Advantage on Investigation and Survival ability checks. You know what is useful, what is edible, and which one matters today.
Advantage on Persuasion and Deception ability checks. The paperwork is missing. The confidence is not.
Advantage on Perception and Stealth ability checks. Notice the trouble before it notices your address.
Advantage on Athletics and SleightOfHand ability checks. Every piece of crushed aluminum is cash if you carry enough bags of it.
Advantage on Performance and Insight ability checks. You know how to hold a crowd, catch a dropped copper, and sense when transit security is coming down the stairs.

Advantage on Intimidation and Insight ability checks. You wipe the windshield first and discuss the fee afterwards. A single look says you know what the driver is thinking about, and what they will pay.
Choose one exploration trade. Each grants advantage on two ability checks. Respec to change your choice.
Maximum Junk increased by 2. Your pockets have annexed the neighbouring pockets.
+1 Armour Class. Every layer of rubbish is another layer of plausible protection.
+3 m movement speed. You have never missed a train you were already chasing.
+3 bonus to Initiative. You have spent years sleeping with one eye open. Nobody catches you flat-footed.
Resistance to Cold damage. Three layers of flattened boxes is a building code if you squint.
Choose more Junk, better protection or faster movement. Respec to change your doctrine.
